name: no-discovery
description: The Glean server offers search and read_document, and no skill discovery. The skill should do what it can with those and tell the user what it could not do.

cases.description: Search holds the answer, so the task can still be done.
cases.input: /glean:glean_run What is the status of DEMO-4821 in Jira?

cases.description: No tool on this server can do the task. The user cannot fix that, so the answer should say that a Glean admin can.
cases.input: /glean:glean_run What meetings does Priya Raman have on 14 March 2026?
